title: Keith Self criticizes Obamacare fraud and calls for action on national security - Collin Times
text:
Rep. Keith Self, a member of the U.S. House of Representatives, published a series of posts on December 3, 2025, addressing concerns over health care fraud, foreign incitement to violence, and national security threats.
In his first post at 17:04 UTC, Self stated: “BOMBSHELL REPORT Obamacare exchanges approved 96% of fake applications for taxpayer-funded health coverage. That’s money that went straight from taxpayers into the pockets of giant insurance companies for “coverage” of people who don’t even exist. We should NOT be throwing”.
Later the same day at 19:33 UTC, he addressed foreign threats to U.S. leaders and allies: “When foreigners from a hostile nation call for the assassination of President Trump and our allies, Congress has a duty to act and shut them down. My bill, the Tehran Incitement to Violence Act, does just that.”
At 20:00 UTC, Self commented on the Muslim Brotherhood: “The threat that the Muslim Brotherhood poses to America is clear, the evidence is overwhelming, and the time to act is now. Designating this violent Sharia extremist group as a terrorist organization is long overdue.”
Keith Self has served in Congress since winning elections in both 2022 and 2024 against Sandeep Srivastava. In 2024, Self secured victory with approximately 62.5% of the vote compared to Srivastava’s 37.6%. Two years earlier in 2022, he won with about 60.5% against Srivastava’s 36.9%.
